chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Katib informed me, saying: al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Za'farani informed us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi informed us, saying: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to me, from Amru ibn Maymun, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather, peace be upon them,

He said: The Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, said from the pulpit of Kufa: O people, indeed the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, granted me ten traits that are more beloved to me than everything upon which the sun has risen.

upon it the sun. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, said to me: O Ali, you are my brother in this world and the hereafter, and you are the closest of creation to me on the Day of Resurrection at the standing before the Almighty, and your dwelling in Paradise faces my dwelling just as the dwellings of brothers in Allah, Mighty and Majestic, face each other, and you are the inheritor from me, and you are the executor after me in my promises and my affairs, and you are the guardian for me among my family during my absence, and you are the Imam for my community, and the upholder of justice over my subjects, and you are my ally, and my ally is the ally of Allah, and your enemy is my enemy, and my enemy is the enemy of Allah.

الإِمَامُ.context: Ali as the divinely-appointed religious and political leader of the Muslim community

الحَافِظُ.context: Ali as the protector of the Prophet’s family during his absence

الوَصِيُّ.context: Ali as the designated executor of the Prophet’s will and affairs after his death

خِصَالٍ.context: Ten specific qualities or privileges the Prophet bestowed upon Ali

وَلِيِّي.context: The relationship of wilayah (guardianship/love) between the Prophet and Ali

ai.seo_question: What are the ten traits that Prophet Muhammad granted to Imam Ali according to his sermon at Kufa?
ai.summary: Imam Ali delivers a sermon from the pulpit of Kufa, enumerating ten traits that the Prophet Muhammad bestowed upon him. These traits encompass brotherhood in both worlds, proximity on the Day of Judgement, neighboring abodes in Paradise, inheritance, successorship (wasiyyah), guardianship of the Prophet’s family, leadership (Imamate) of the community, upholding justice, mutual love, and shared enmity with enemies of Allah. This hadith, delivered publicly to the people of Kufa during Ali’s caliphate, served as a reminder of his divinely-appointed station and the Prophet’s explicit declarations of his authority.
